name: Ghostline Paste Relay
description: The Ghostline hacker collective's paste server has gone quiet, and a courier's last transmission hints that its crew record is still reachable. On the lab network, scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), investigate the reachable services, and recover the protected record.

tasks.name: Recover the crew record
tasks.description: A courier's last transmission points to the Ghostline collective's paste infrastructure. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Investigate the reachable services and recover the protected crew record.
hints: Compare the reachable services and look for information the collective left publicly readable.
The paste server has a public note with account details. See whether those details work at another reachable service.
After logging in to the remote terminal, look in the account's home directory for the crew record.
